name: 3 Hatch Spire
notes: Three or more hatcheries down before the Lair, then Spire: the economic three-base muta structure. Later Lair timing than 2 or 2.5 hatch spire because the third base comes first. Structure only, opening-agnostic. No Hydralisk Den before the Spire: a den-first game is a hydra opening that added a spire later, not this build.
